title: American pilots trained to fly UFOs despite time displacement

tellings.quote: they conveyed to him that they were training pilots to fly UFOs.

plain: American pilots are being trained in a deep underground facility in California to fly UFOs, despite what the story calls time displacement, an effect of flying the craft on the pilots' sense of time. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells Michels that people there told this to Lyn Buchanan, a former military remote viewer, meaning someone trained to gather information by psychic means. If so, the US would have working UFOs and people to fly them.
